title: Component
subtitle: Zoomed into All Containers (SPA, Mobile App, API Application, Database)
description: Zoomed-In Containers: every upper-layer container is carried forward with an enlarged transparent border, opening up to explain all internal components inside it.
note: All upper-layer Containers are carried forward with enlarged transparent borders so no container disappears when moving from Container to Component layer.

boundaries.label: Single-Page & Mobile Channels
boundaries.subtitle: Upper Layer: Container (Zoomed In) · Angular SPA & Xamarin Mobile
boundaries.description: Client-side channel containers opened up to show their internal UI & API client components.

boundaries.label: API Application
boundaries.subtitle: Upper Layer: Container (Zoomed In) · Java, Spring Boot, Docker
boundaries.description: Provides Internet banking functionality via a JSON/HTTPS REST API — zoomed in to show controllers & services.

boundaries.label: Database
boundaries.subtitle: Upper Layer: Container (Zoomed In) · PostgreSQL / SQL Database
boundaries.description: Relational database container opened up to show its internal schema & audit table components.
